propositions: A failed tickets-branch push is silent on async (detached Popen with stderr=DEVNULL), library (NullHandler on root, no stderr_handler installed), MCP (server stderr unread by agent), and reconciler (logs under wrong root) paths, making git rejection reasons and backlog increments completely undeliverable to users.

The remedy is a durable marker recorded in the git dir at _raise_if_strict choke point for all terminal failures, exposed as rebar.push_status() to library callers and as push_status field on MCP write-tool results, cleared when a push succeeds.

The marker location in git dir (not working tree) is structural: preserves byte-identical git status after a failed push that reconciles non-fast-forward via stash-commit-merge-restore dance, and follows linked worktree gitdir: pointers without subprocesses.

Non-failure reasons (push-disabled, async-delivery-unobservable, remote-not-found, invalid-destination) are excluded from recording to prevent alarm fatigue in local-only stores that never attempt push; all other terminal reasons including commit-phase and recovery reasons are recorded.

The async path is observable via polling the marker on a bounded 60s/0.1s deadline despite detached child with start_new_session=True never being waited; marker presence and reason are independently verified by mutation checking (removing record_failure turns 5 behavior tests red, removing clear calls turns marker-clear test red).

Every write-tool advertising a schema gains push_status field as strict superset of existing result field, except declare_no_file_impact which remains structured_output=False exempt; schema drift gate and coverage test confirm no regression.
